input.architecture: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript, SVG charts hand-rendered for full visual control (no heavyweight chart lib). src/data/eventEngine.ts is the single seeded simulation (mulberry32 PRNG; candles/equity/agents/activity/thresholds); src/data/AgentStream.tsx exposes one React context with an interval tick plus pause/resume, consumed by cards, charts, tickers and the SVG pixel room. Layout: top status bar, 8-card grid, pixel room, equity/analysis/threshold panels. CSS variables and breakpoints for 1440/1024/390. Vitest + Testing Library (jsdom) for behavior; playwright-core against installed Chrome for viewport screenshots and overflow assertions.
requirements: Runnable Vite React+TS app in D:\npqo with a dark pixel-terminal visual language inspired by the reference image (not copied literally).
Exactly 8 agent cards (CHIEF, SCAN, VET, SOCIAL, SIZE, FILLS, RISK, CRAWLER) whose metrics update from the live event stream, with pause/resume control.
Dynamic financial charts: live equity area chart with hover tooltip, candlestick/volume chart, card sparklines and tickers fed by the same stream.
Central pixel-art room with multiple workstations, agents, monitors, vault/server decor, animated cables, scanlines and event-reactive labels.
A single deterministic simulated event source (seeded engine + provider) consumed by all sections, with no per-component fake timers.
Responsive layouts at 1440px, 1024px and 390px without horizontal overflow, verified in a real browser.
Automated tests (engine determinism, stream/provider, 8 cards, pause, charts, room) and saved screenshots at all three widths.
input.summary: Build a runnable React+TS trading-desk dashboard in the otherwise empty npqo project: 8 live agent cards, dynamic equity/candle charts, a central pixel-art room, one seeded simulated event stream, responsive layouts, Vitest coverage, and real browser screenshots at 1440/1024/390.

steps.text: Scaffold Vite React+TS project, install dependencies/fonts, and implement the seeded event engine plus all dashboard UI and responsive CSS.
Add Vitest + Testing Library tests for engine determinism, unified stream updates/pause, 8 agent cards, charts and pixel room; run them.
Run the app in a real headless Chrome at 1440, 1024 and 390 widths, assert no horizontal overflow and save screenshots to screenshots/.
